shortDescription: Manage port groups on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: new_name
options.description: New name of the port group while renaming. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port_group_protocol
options.description: Port Group protocol. Required only for V4(Juniper).

options.name: port_state
options.description: Define whether the port should be present or absent in the port group. present-in-group - indicates that the ports should be present on a port group object. absent-in-group - indicates that the ports should not be present on a port group object.

options.name: portgroup_name
options.description: The name of the port group. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: ports
options.description: List of directors and ports to be added or removed to or from the port group.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the port group should exist or not. present - indicates that the port group should be present on the system. absent - indicates that the port group should not be present on the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
